other_measurements.label: composite safety outcome up to day 7
named: The primary safety outcome was a composite of death, serious adverse events, and grade 3 or 4 adverse events up to day 7.
result: The percentage with the composite safety outcome at day 7 was similar for the hIVIG (24%) and placebo groups (25%; OR 0·98, 95% CI 0·66–1·46; p=0·91).

other_measurements.label: composite safety outcome up to day 28
named: The composite safety outcome at day 28 included all of the outcomes used in the day 7 safety outcome except grade 3 and 4 adverse events.
result: The HR for the day 28 composite safety outcome was 0·79 (95% CI 0·57–1·11; tables 2; appendix p 47).

other_measurements.label: ordinal outcome at day 7 (death as category 7)
named: The primary endpoint was an ordinal outcome based on the patient's clinical status on day 7 (appendix p 14). The seven categories of this outcome ranged from return to usual activities with no more than minimal symptoms due to COVID-19, to death.
result: The OR for being in a more favourable outcome in the hIVIG group compared with placebo on day 7 was 1·06 (95% CI 0·77–1·45; p=0·72; figure 2 ; table 2 ).
